item.title: Limerick pioneer of women’s soccer has passed away
item.description: A PIONEERING women’s soccer player has passed away. Pauline Maher of Punch Close and formerly of Roundwood, Rosbrien died after a short illness at University Hospital Limerick on Saturday. Back in 1973, Maher became the first player from Limerick to score for the Republic of Ireland at senior level when she netted against Northern Ireland.
